exhibit_title: WORK ORDER NO. #1 TO THE FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT
note: bon de travail n° 1 : conception, développement, fabrication et fourniture des fourgons de livraison, plateformes et pièces pour Amazon ; mentionne une « Investment Fee » non chiffrée dans l'en-tête ; corps à lire en passe C (D-0036)
quote: This Work Order No. #1 (this "Work Order"), between Amazon Logistics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Amazon"), and Rivian Automotive, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Rivian"), is effective as of September 16, 2019 ("WO Effective Date"), and is entered into pursuant to the Framework Agreement between Amazon and Rivian, effective as of September 16, 2019 (the "Agreement").
